thread:
olivia: Hey team — multiple customers reporting console graphs completely blank this morning. Troubleshooting shows 500s from analytics API around 12:37Z. Sentry link: https://sentry.company/issue/ABC-123 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-043. Notifying oncall.

eng-dan: Do we have a reproduction? sample route/params?

olivia: Repro steps from support ticket: open /dashboards/financials -> last 24h -> panels fail to load. Seen on both us-east and eu-west. Sample request id: rcid=5f3a9b8c. From logs:
```
2026-03-17T12:37:09Z ERROR analytics-proxy failed to fetch /query?panel_id=873 status=500 err="timeout to clickhouse (read)" req_id=5f3a9b8c
2026-03-17T12:37:10Z WARN aggregator-v2 high-latency batch=42 avg_ms=1300
```

sre-ana: I can see a spike in 5xx from analytics-proxy around that window. Graph of error-rate: https://grafana.company/d/alerts/err-rate (internal). Looks correlated with a ClickHouse replica promotion around 12:34Z — there was a failover.

eng-dan: Is aggregator-v2 handling retries incorrectly? If clickhouse is slow, we might be queuing and timing out. Any recent deploys?

olivia: aggregator-v2 rolled at 12:20Z per deploy-bot: "deployed aggregator-v2 to analytics cluster". Might be related.

sre-ana: I'm going to triage. Quick mitigation: reduce fanout from dashboard queries to 2 and enable lightweight fallback route that queries materialized summary table. Running temporary config patch now.

eng-dan: Also try this repro curl (to reproduce the exact query):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.company/analytics/query?panel_id=873&range=24h" -o /tmp/resp.json
jq '.error' /tmp/resp.json
```

olivia: Applied mitigation at 12:48Z — patched routing to fallback-summary. Observed partial recovery: error-rate dropped from ~72% -> ~18% over next 4m.

deploy-bot: Rollback option available: rollback aggregator-v2 to previous revision r2026-78. Approve? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

eng-dan: Approving rollback. I'll coordinate rollback and then monitor.

sre-ana: Rollback started at 12:52Z. Watching metrics.

olivia: After rollback completed 12:57Z, graphs for affected dashboards started loading again for most customers. Some panels still show stale data (delayed by ~15-20m).

customer-james: Confirmed on call — graphs are coming back. Thank you. Still seeing some missing series in the "revenue by region" panel though.

eng-dan: That missing series is likely due to aggregation windows being rebuilt after failover. Will run a catchup job to repopulate the materialized view for last 2 hours. Command I'll run: `python tools/rebuild_mv.py --table revenue_hourly --from -120m`

sre-ana: Postmortem action items:
- rollback safety check for aggregator deploys
- make fallback-summary auto-enable on DB failover
- add alert that ties clickhouse topology changes to analytics 5xx
- run a one-off MV catchup for affected windows (eng)

olivia: Marking this as P1 for support until all panels fully recover. I filed a follow-up ticket: TKT-7783.

eng-dan: Adding note to deploy changelog about missing retry-bounds. Will write a patch to backoff earlier.

customer-james: All good for now. I'll reopen if I see more blank panels. Thanks everyone :heart:
